name: 1931 China Floods
description: The deadliest natural disaster in recorded history. Seasonal floods across central China inundated an area the size of England, destroying crops and triggering famine.

name: 1970 Bhola Cyclone
description: The deadliest tropical cyclone on record struck East Pakistan (now Bangladesh), with a storm surge devastating the low-lying Ganges Delta region.

name: 1976 Tangshan Earthquake
description: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake struck the industrial city of Tangshan while residents slept, leveling nearly the entire city within seconds.

name: 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami
description: A 9.1 magnitude undersea earthquake generated waves up to 30 meters tall, striking 14 countries across South and Southeast Asia.

name: 2010 Haiti Earthquake
description: A catastrophic 7.0 magnitude earthquake struck near Port-au-Prince, collapsing poorly constructed buildings and leaving 1.5 million homeless.

name: 1918 Spanish Flu
description: The most severe pandemic in modern history infected an estimated 500 million people worldwide, killing 5% of the global population in two years.

name: 2020 COVID-19
description: A novel coronavirus emerged in late 2019 and spread globally, triggering the first worldwide pandemic in a century and reshaping modern society.

name: 2005 Hurricane Katrina
description: The costliest and one of the deadliest hurricanes in U.S. history breached New Orleans' levees, flooding 80% of the city for weeks.

name: 1986 Chernobyl Disaster
description: Reactor No. 4 at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant exploded during a safety test, releasing radioactive contamination across Europe. Long-term casualties remain disputed.

name: 2011 Tōhoku Earthquake
description: A 9.1 magnitude earthquake off Japan's Pacific coast triggered massive tsunamis that overwhelmed coastal defenses, also causing meltdowns at the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant.
